attempted_claim: Prove or disprove the following periodicity-closing statement. Let Gamma be w^2 = E(E-1)(E-2)(E-3)(E-4) plus infinity, genus 2. Let uq be the real Its-Matveev potential on R for the gap-confined divisor with mu1=1.2 on the upper sheet over [1,2] and mu2=3.8 on the upper sheet over [3,4] at x=0. Claim: uq has no real period T>0, i.e. it is strictly quasi-periodic with R-incommensurate x-frequencies. Parameter scope is all real T>0. A complete answer is either a rigorous proof of aperiodicity via certified R-incommensurability of the two Abelian-integral frequency components, or an explicit period T>0 with a rigorous certificate that uq(x+T)=uq(x) for all real x, verified by frequency-integral enclosure and theta-function evaluation.
decisive_failure: The investigation reduced the admitted periodicity question to the rationality of one explicit period-matrix ratio and enclosed it to 100 digits, but a non-interval enclosure plus bounded continued-fraction and PSLQ exclusion cannot certify (ir)rationality over all denominators. No period-independence or exact-evaluation theorem for this genus-2 Jacobian was available locally, so neither the aperiodicity proof nor an explicit certified period could be completed within the pass.
